rows.section: Contractors: employment status, off-payroll working (IR35) and the Construction Industry Scheme
rows.label: Official employment-status test
rows.value: HMRC's Check employment status for tax (CEST) tool gives HMRC's view of whether a worker is employed or self-employed for tax; HMRC stands by the result if the information given is accurate, and it can be used as a status determination statement. Detailed rules: HMRC Employment Status Manual
rows.note: CIS deductions count as advance payments towards the subcontractor's Income Tax and National Insurance.
